axes.non_collapse_note: Factual discipline here is the C12 axis form (binary, no-misrepresentation). It is NOT the subset-(a) BIB-4D-4 'functional_completeness' dim. The two are scored independently under different criteria and reported separately.

per_axis_gate: Each axis is independently evaluated. A per-axis C12-axis-BROKEN call is a hard fail on that axis (per proposal v5.1 §5.4 STEP 1).
important_analytical_separation_pr_INSA_: DO NOT concatenate the BIB 4-dim (subset-(a)) and the 8 C12 axes (subset-(b)) into a 12-dim Manhattan. They are evaluated under their own criteria and reported as two disjoint preservation reports. This separation is a v0.3 / proposal-v5.1 PREREGISTERED rule; it is consistent with v0.1 §11.3 'Important analytical separation (C11 ruling)'.
non_collapse_attestation_pr_INSA_ID_E1: Subset-(b) is the 8-axis C12 set ONLY; the calibrated BIB 4-dim vector belongs to subset-(a). The two subsets are disjoint per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1 non-collapse attestation. The two subsets have different ID namespaces (BIB-4D-* vs C12-*). The axis labels of subset-(b) are preserved verbatim from v0.1 §11.3 and intentionally overlap in display name with some subset-(a) dim labels; the IDs are disjoint and the criteria are different.
